candidates.name: Simple Feature Access - Part 1: Common Architecture
verified_facts: Simple Feature Access defines common geometry classes such as Point, Curve, Surface and GeometryCollection.
Geometric objects are associated with a spatial reference system.
semantic_limits: Geometry type validity and a declared spatial reference system do not establish survey precision, exact legal-boundary status or terrain measurement quality.

candidates.name: GeoPackage Standard
verified_facts: GeoPackage is a portable SQLite container for standards-based geospatial content.
It can contain vector features and tile matrix sets of imagery or raster maps.
semantic_limits: A valid GeoPackage schema or container does not certify source recency, vertical datum, LiDAR accuracy or HMLR boundary authority.
